# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** eleven  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with a vivacious face, rosy cheeks, and black eyes. She is noted for her glossy, jet-black hair.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Personality

Diana Barry is a practical, ladylike, and sympathetic girl who is considered a good, kind, and sweet companion. Known as a very comfortable friend, she also possesses a notable taste in dressing that makes her advice on the subject much sought after.

## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who was boarding at her home at the time of her birth. She became instant best friends with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after meeting her in the [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) garden, where they swore a solemn oath of friendship. When Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) temporarily forbade them from playing together, Diana secretly sent [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a note at school, and she later rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to seek Anne's help when her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell severely ill with croup. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) permitted the girls to be best friends once again. During a game of dares at her party, Diana watched [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fall from Mr.

## Quotes

> “Why, I guess so,” she said frankly. “I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) became instant, devoted best friends who swore a solemn oath of friendship upon meeting, eventually establishing [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild) as playmates. Though Diana's mother temporarily separated them, their bond endured through secret notes and was fully restored after they worked together as comrades through the night to save Diana's sick sister. Diana remains a steadfast confidante and supporter of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), helping her prepare for major events like her [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) recital and riding home with her afterward.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042), +40 more_
